events.event: Jensen Huang resigned immediately as CEO, president and board member of Nvidia, which he co-founded in 1993, and CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO, hours after a WSJ report that the board was weighing his future over an alleged affair with Alice Huang, reportedly suspected by US officials of being a Chinese spy.
events.key_numbers: Nvidia market value above US$4 triliun · Founded 1993 · Announced 12 Nov 2026 (detik 21:14 WIB) · CNBC Indonesia: 240 ribu chip Nvidia reportedly smuggled to China (unverified)
events.why_it_matters: The head of the company that powers the global AI boom is gone overnight, which moves AI stocks and chip supply.
events.spreading_evidence: Dominates CNBC Indonesia Tech and CNN Indonesia Teknologi lists on 12 Nov (8+ articles)

events.event: Counterpoint Research said Samsung led Indonesia's smartphone market in Q3 2026 with 33% share while total shipments fell 43% year on year, the third straight quarterly decline, blamed on a memory supply crunch from AI data-centre demand.
events.key_numbers: Total shipments -43% YoY · Samsung 33% (from ~21%), -5% · Xiaomi 21%, -33% · Oppo 16%, -64% · Infinix 11%, -51% · Vivo 8%, -67% · Under US$150 segment 55% to 24% of market · Above US$700 segment 3% to 10%
events.why_it_matters: Cheap phones are disappearing from the Indonesian market, so buyers are pushed to pricier models.

events.event: Counterpoint's price tracker, cited by CNBC Indonesia, shows average global smartphone retail prices up about 15% in 2026, with phones launched in 2026 averaging about 25% above their predecessors, while XLSMART bundles phones with data and Gemini access to keep buyers.
events.key_numbers: Global avg price +15% in 2026 · 2026 launches ~+25% vs predecessors · XLSMART Galaxy S26 FE bundle with 6 months Gemini/Google storage valued ~Rp700.000
events.why_it_matters: Your next phone will likely cost noticeably more, and operators are using bundles to soften it.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported Ripple's API specification (Payments Direct 2026.03) restored rupiah payouts through BI-FAST, effective 10 November, without any confirmed partnership with Bank Indonesia and without being commercially live.
events.key_numbers: Per transaction Rp50.000 to Rp100 juta (provider limit; BI-FAST general limit Rp250 juta) · Daily per recipient Rp750 juta · Support added Jul 2026, removed Sep, restored 10 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Could make sending money to Indonesian bank accounts from abroad faster, but it is a spec listing, not a launch.

events.event: Komdigi minister Meutya Hafid inaugurated eight officials in a reshuffle including a new head of Humas and the Secretary of the Dewan Pers, saying evaluation of other sectors would continue.
events.why_it_matters: Signals more shake-ups at the ministry that sets platform and data rules.

events.event: Fortinet Threatmap showed banking as the most-targeted sector in Indonesia, and a cyber expert said high detection counts do not mean customer funds are at risk; no bank breach was named.
events.key_numbers: Banking ~761.000 detected threats · Technology 386.000 · Government 121.000 · 1,6 juta attacks blocked in 24h vs 50.600 on 7 Nov · ~4 detections per second · Snapshot 9 Nov 08:41 WIB
events.why_it_matters: People worry about bank savings; the data shows attempts, not successful breaches.

events.event: Binance said it has finished covering all of the roughly US$6.3 billion stolen in the 29 October hack, with new proof-of-reserves pending, per Quartz and crypto.news headlines.
events.key_numbers: ~US$6,3 miliar stolen · Coverage reported complete · Proof of reserves pending
events.why_it_matters: Closes an open question in the Binance hack story: whether users lose money.
